name: intake-01
title: Intake 01 - A Stream Of Arriving Work, Fed By The Consumer
description: A stream of arriving work with a source, a subject, a moment drawn through relative-time, a state tone beside the caller's own words, and up to two controls whose labels are functions of the item. A Block and not a live surface: it holds no socket, no poll and no timer, and its content changes when the consumer re-renders it with a new array. An href with no words is refused and a state with no words is refused, because a coloured dot with no sentence beside it is invisible. Every string is passed in as a prop.
